Requirement: Users can create an account and log in securely
Users can manually add a recipe with title, ingredients, steps, tags, and image
Users can paste a URL to import recipe metadata and structured content if available
If parsing fails, store recipe as metadata + link only
Users can browse recipes in a card-based grid layout
Users can search and filter recipes by tags
Users can view recipes in Cook Mode with step-by-step navigation, large text, timers, and wake-lock
Users can export their recipes as JSON or CSV
Application is responsive and mobile-first
Users can upload an image or screenshot to import recipe via OCR
Importer parses more blog formats and improves structured parsing
New imports land in a Recipe Inbox for tagging and cleanup
Auto-tagging suggestions generated for new recipes
Users can create shopping lists from recipes
Ingredients in shopping lists are normalized and deduplicated
Users can scale servings and convert units between US/metric
Shopping list groups items by aisle (Produce, Dairy, Pantry)
Users can publish their own recipes to public pages with shareable links
Creators can integrate their recipes via schema-based import and embed cards
Users can save custom filter views (e.g., 15-min vegetarian dinners)
Pro users can create multiple shopping lists
Pro users can view weekly planning view with consolidated lists
Pro users can export shopping lists as PDF, CSV, or Markdown
Pro users have access to advanced import tools (OCR batch, more sites)
Users can maintain a lightweight pantry list
Users can filter recipes based on pantry items
Users can track leftovers with expiry dates
Users can export owned recipes into a styled PDF for printing
Users can order print-on-demand cookbooks of owned recipes
Users can share cookbooks with family members and collaborate
Cooking courses with creators, including video and premium guides
Gamification with badges, streaks, and challenges
AI-based substitutions and pantry recommendations
Meal planning calendar with drag-and-drop recipes
Nutrition tracking and auto-macro estimates
Integration with grocery delivery APIs for shopping list export
Voice integration with smart speakers for hands-free cook mode
App shall comply with all laws and copyright requirements
App shall include a 'Report abuse' button on public recipe pages
App shall implement a DMCA/Notice & Takedown workflow
App shall include Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, and Content Policy available to users
